title: Actual finite-Q3 local Duhamel-word incidence and degree escalation
question: Does a concrete local word built from the canonical Q3 onsite and one spatial-bond potential have a nonzero source coefficient of degree 4m-3?
method: Restrict the canonical onsite quartic and the three incident Q3 lock edges at species 000 with the other species set to zero, deriving G=g+3*lambda.
Form the exact shifted onsite difference and one selected spatial-bond difference from the canonical polynomial potentials.
Compute the ordered word with m-1 onsite factors and one bond factor, its m-position multiplication-word sum, and the exact source degree for m=1 through 6.
Run independent SymPy and sparse-polynomial Fraction lanes and compile Lean R220 for the rational degree and coefficient fixtures.
finding: The selected word is an actual local polynomial word of the canonical Q3 split. Its ordered coefficient is -c*(-G/4)^(m-1)*a^(4m-3), and the m-position sum is m times this nonzero coefficient for every tested word length. The degree-five/fixed-weight escalation is therefore an actual local-word witness, not only a prescribed abstract family.
decision_reason: This closes the local incidence question while preserving the full-history firewall. The calculation is restricted to one species coordinate and one selected bond; it does not determine the signed complete Duhamel coefficient or a resummable source topology.

adversarial_review.check: Both factors are derived from the canonical Q3 lock and one spatial quadratic bond.
Zeroing the other species and sites makes this a local coefficient witness, not a full-volume estimate.
The m factor counts multiplication-word insertion positions and is not a full operator-series sign theorem.
No cancellation or noncancellation conclusion is inferred for the complete Duhamel series.
R220 checks scalar rational fixtures only, not domains or convergence.
No thermodynamic dynamics, KMS, GNS gap, continuum, C6, Sector A or Pre-A result is claimed.
